answer: Behavioral plume clustering: score each identity’s action traces across sessions, flagging tight groups whose timing and resource targets overlap beyond chance. Flagged clusters enter a quartz audit queue where independent reviewers sample histories; confirmed clusters are quarantined. An attacker must maintain distinct, low-overlap behavior per identity—costing separate infrastructure, content, and aged accounts per sybil. Honest users keep an oasis of stable history that survives review.
